### God’s Unchanging Heart for His Profoundly Imperfect People
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/gods-unchanging-heart-for-his-profoundly-imperfect-people-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 103:8
Points:
- Believers often assume God withdraws affection when they fail, but His character remains steadfast.
- David echoes God's revelation to Moses, exalting His enduring patience, mercy, and grace.
- The Lord recognizes human frailty and treats His people with the tender compassion of a loving parent.
- Divine acceptance is rooted entirely in God's goodness and secured through Christ's redeeming sacrifice.

### Forget Not His Benefits
Author: Joan Walker Hahn
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/forget-not-his-benefits-encouragement-cafe-may-12.html
Passage: Psalm 103:1-2
Points:
- Genuine praise is cultivated when believers deliberately choose to remember God's past faithfulness.
- Like David during seasons of danger and solitude, we must train our souls to bless the Lord.
- God bestows continual blessings, including forgiveness, healing, redemption, and renewed spiritual strength.
- Reflecting on God's unmerited grace helps believers overcome anxiety and fear in difficult trials.

### Psalm 103: Learning How to Talk (to Yourself)
Author: Ryan Griffith
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/psalm-103-learning-how-to-talk-to-yourself
Passage: Psalm 103:1-22
Points:
- Believers must actively preach biblical truth to their own hearts during seasons of low spiritual affection.
- Recalling God's historical acts of redemption lifts our gaze above distressing circumstances.
- David anchored his troubled soul by clinging to the scriptural truth of God's steadfast mercy.
- Grasping how completely God removes transgressions transforms a faltering spirit into heartfelt worship.

### Created to Praise
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/created-to-praise
Passage: Psalm 103:1-22
Points:
- God created humanity with the ultimate calling and purpose of knowing and glorifying Him.
- Daily cares and distractions often crowd out worship, making intentional praise essential in prayer.
- Psalm 103 instructs believers to recount both God's holy character and His righteous deeds.
- Remembering God's benefits reorients our focus away from worry and toward thankful adoration.
